play.checking: Check your answers against the card.
play.personalHint: Tap a square to grey it out. Tap again to remove the mark.
play.resetWarning: A new game replaces your board, marks and answer at this level.
play.replaceRound: The current round is still in progress. Moving on clears the saved answers and countdown.
play.helpDigital: Everyone plays on their own phone. Tap a square to grey it out; tap again to remove the mark. Undo reverses the last move. Your answer opens a full-screen answer type and entry form. Confirming covers your answer — tap the screen to reveal it. The host can expand Round controls, draw a category and start the 25-second timer when the music begins. Each device saves its own board.
play.hostHint: Hosting the game? Draw a category and start the 25-second timer here. Everyone else plays on their own phone.
play.helpBingo: Five marked squares in a row, column or diagonal make Bingo and trigger confetti and fireworks. Settle all answers and bonuses from the same round. If needed, judge a tie-break together after the next song.
